content: Backend: crm.py models + routers, hook /api/contact → CRM, Clerk-protected endpoints
Frontend: ClerkAuthProvider wiring, /sign-in route, admin shell layout + sidebar
Frontend admin pages: Dashboard, Contacts, Companies, Leads Kanban, Opportunities, Inbox, Calendar, Appointments, Tasks, Research, Analytics, Automations, Integrations, Settings
Public: attribution hook (UTM + cookie) + Appointment booking widget on Contact page
